1672 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century exception because 1600 is a leap year but 1700 is not, so 1672 is leap).  
09-09-1672 minus 249 days:  
First, go back 9 days to 1672-08-31.  
Remaining 240 days: go back 240 days from 1672-08-31.  
240 days before Aug 31: Jan has 31, Feb has 29 (leap), Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31.  
From Aug 31 back 31 days → Jul 31 (1 month), back another 31 → Jun 30 (2 months), back 30 → May 31 (3 months), back 31 → Apr 30 (4 months), back 30 → Mar 31 (5 months), back 31 → Feb 29 (6 months), back 29 → Jan 31 (7 months), back 31 → Dec 31, 1671 (8 months).  
Count: Jan 31 (31), Feb 29 (60), Mar 31 (91), Apr 30 (121), May 31 (152), Jun 30 (182), Jul 31 (213), Aug 31 (244) days from Jan 1 to Aug 31 inclusive? Wait, better:  
Days from Jan 1 to Aug 31 in leap year = 31+29+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 244 days. So Aug 31 is day 244 of 1672.  
Going back 240 days from Aug 31: day 244 - 240 = day 4 of the year.  
Day 4 of leap year = Jan 4.  
So 240 days before Aug 31, 1672 = Jan 4, 1672.  
But we subtracted 9 days first to get to Aug 31, then 240 days = total 249 days.  
Check: Jan 4, 1672 to Aug 31, 1672 = 240 days, plus 9 days to Sep 9 = 249 days. Correct.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1672-01-04
